title: Part Eight: Health: The System Inside the System

sections.brief: Wartime origin of job-based insurance (1942 wage controls, 1943 ruling, 1954 code) as designed friction and the tax exclusion's size; national spending vs outcomes (CMS NHE, WHO PPP, Commonwealth Fund 2026); KFF EHBS 2026 premiums and deductibles; uninsured and underinsured; enhanced-subsidy expiry and the 2025 law's Medicaid changes, status October 2026; where it works. Figures: time; stats; compare (told vs record)

Marketplace claim denials (KFF 2024 data), Medicare Advantage prior authorization, the 2025 insurer pledge and industry position; FTC PBM reports and insulin settlements, 2026 PBM law; hospital and drug prices (RAND) with AHA and PCMA responses; designed vs captured friction. Figures: flow; money; compare

Three medical-debt measures (CFPB $88bn, Peterson-KFF $220bn, KFF 41%) and why they differ; who carries it; medical credit cards; Himmelstein vs Dobkin bankruptcy dispute; bureau changes, vacated CFPB rule, CFPB preemption interpretation and state laws as of October 2026; labelled interpretation with counter-readings. Figures: compare; money
